definitions.aerialWon: aerial_won flag on Pass / Clearance / Shot / Miscontrol
definitions.tacklesWon: Duel type Tackle, outcome Won / Success / Success In Play / Success Out
definitions.clearances: Clearance events without aerial_won (aerial clearances count once, as aerialWon)
definitions.headedXg: non-penalty xG of shots with body_part Head
definitions.passesIntoBox: completed open-play pass from outside the box ending inside it (x>=102, 18<=y<=62)
definitions.progPasses: completed open-play pass ending >=25% closer to the goal centre (120,40)
definitions.progCarries: carry ending >=25% and >=5 units closer to the goal centre
definitions.receptionsBetweenLines: successful Ball Receipt at x 78-102, y 18-62 (location proxy; no 360 data)
definitions.interceptionsWon: Interception outcome Won / Success In Play / Success Out
definitions.xa: non-penalty xG of shots whose key_pass_id is the player's pass
definitions.xgChain: non-penalty xG of every possession in which the player had a Pass / Carry / successful Receipt / Dribble / Shot
definitions.xgBuildup: xgChain excluding possessions in which the player took a shot or played the key pass
definitions.npxg: non-penalty xG of the player's own shots
